fields.acceptance_criteria: caller_model strings with a trailing parenthetical client qualifier such as Claude Sonnet 5 (copilot) resolve to the correct price-table entry; space and underscore separators are normalized to hyphens; normalization runs in the MCP transport wrapper before Gate and only as a fallback after exact and substring matching fail; exact-match precedence is unchanged; a normalized non-exact match succeeds and emits a soft warning in the response; genuinely unknown models are still rejected; the rejection message includes a compact list of detected available models; unknown_model_guidance text reflects the new tolerance; unit tests cover parenthetical-suffix separator-normalization and still-unknown cases; MCP tool docs and examples are updated for the relaxed caller_model format
fields.title: [mcp-cost-gate] Tolerate common caller_model naming deviations instead of rejecting the call
